reason: I'd maybe look at the free version, but I wouldn't pay. WhatsApp and my own memory already work fine, and I hate subscriptions.
objection: I already throw away a bit of food, but I don't believe scanning receipts every shop is something I'll keep doing. Another app to open means another habit, and I'd pay for it by the month.
would_change_my_mind: If the free version alone really saved me food waste, I'd keep using it. Paying only if it were a one-time price, not a subscription.
